gain.label: Level
gain.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0.1 to 6.

pres_lin.label: Dynamics (even)
pres_lin.hover: The even part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and a light touch already speaks. Range 0 to 1.

pres_sq.label: Dynamics (curved)
pres_sq.hover: The curved part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and the loud end opens up faster than the soft end. Range 0 to 1.5.

pres_hz.label: Response
pres_hz.hover: How quickly the sound follows a change of pressure: low is a slow swell, high is immediate. Range 2 to 200 Hz.

release.label: Release
release.hover: How long the sound takes to die away after the key is released. Range 0.005 to 1 s.

rel_pedal.label: Release with pedal
rel_pedal.hover: How much longer the release gets with the sustain pedal down. Range 0 to 3 s.

lip_soft.label: Lips, soft
lip_soft.hover: How closed the lips play when soft: -2 pure and round, towards 0.8 buzzy. Range -2 to 0.8.

lip_loud.label: Lips, loud
lip_loud.hover: How closed the lips play when loud: -2 pure and round, 0.85 buzzy. Range -2 to 0.85.

lip_tilt.label: Lips by timbre
lip_tilt.hover: How much timbre firms the lips: up brightens. Range -0.5 to 0.5.

jitter.label: Jitter
jitter.hover: A fine, fast roughness of the pitch, like a living lip. Range 0 to 20 cents.

breath.label: Breath noise
breath.hover: The audible breath in the tone. Range 0 to 0.8.

brassiness.label: Brassiness
brassiness.hover: How much the tone blares and steepens as it gets loud. Range 0 to 60.

bore_decay.label: Bore decay
bore_decay.hover: How long the tube's resonance rings: the bloom and the tail. Range 0.005 to 0.2 s.

bell_hz.label: Bell cutoff
bell_hz.hover: The frequency above which the bell stops reflecting: the resonances above it fade. Range 150 to 4000 Hz.

rad_hz.label: Radiation low cut
rad_hz.hover: The frequency below which the instrument radiates less. Range 20 to 2000 Hz.

cup_hz.label: Cup formant
cup_hz.hover: Where the mouthpiece cup's formant sits. Range 150 to 3000 Hz.

cup_q.label: Cup sharpness
cup_q.hover: How narrow the cup formant is. Range 0.5 to 5.

cup_gain.label: Cup boost
cup_gain.hover: How much the cup formant is boosted. Range 0 to 4.

tone_hz.label: Tone
tone_hz.hover: The brightness of the radiated tone: the frequency above which it rolls off. Range 500 to 12000 Hz.

tone_q.label: Tone sharpness
tone_q.hover: How sharp the tone roll-off is. Range 0.5 to 2.

tone_dyn.label: Tone by dynamics
tone_dyn.hover: How many octaves darker the tone gets when soft. Range 0 to 4 octaves.

tilt_tone.label: Tone by timbre
tilt_tone.hover: How far timbre moves the tone: down is darker and more closed. Range -2 to 2 octaves.

mute.label: Mute
mute.hover: How deep the mute sits in the bell: 0 open. Range 0 to 1.

mute_hz.label: Mute resonance
mute_hz.hover: Where the mute's resonance sits. Range 300 to 5000 Hz.

mute_q.label: Mute sharpness
mute_q.hover: How sharp the mute's resonance is. Range 0.5 to 10.

mute_hp.label: Straight mute
mute_hp.hover: The straight-mute character: how much of the highs pass. Range 0 to 3.

mute_bp.label: Harmon mute
mute_bp.hover: The harmon-mute character: how much of the resonant middle passes. Range 0 to 4.

mute_lp.label: Mute lows
mute_lp.hover: How much of the lows pass the mute. Range 0 to 2.

wah.label: Wah
wah.hover: How far timbre moves the mute's resonance: up opens it. Range -2 to 2 octaves.

tongue.label: Strike
tongue.hover: How much a hard strike sharpens the start: the tongue's hold and release, the accent and the "t". Range 0 to 2.

acc_level.label: Accent
acc_level.hover: The extra push at the start of a struck note: 0 none, higher is a sharper attack. Range 0 to 1.5.

acc_decay.label: Accent length
acc_decay.hover: How long the accent lasts before the note settles. Range 0.01 to 0.3 s.

acc_bright.label: Accent brightness
acc_bright.hover: How much brighter the start of a struck note is than the sustain. Range 0 to 1.5.

scoop.label: Scoop
scoop.hover: How far the pitch scoops up from below at a strike. Range 0 to 1.5 semitones.

blat.label: Blat
blat.hover: The buzzy pitch flutter during a hard attack. Range 0 to 1.5 semitones.

t_noise.label: Tongue "t"
t_noise.hover: The short noise burst of a tongued start. Range 0 to 1.

slur.label: Slur
slur.hover: How much articulation a legato note change gets: 0 seamless, 1 each new note is re-tongued. Range 0 to 1.

vibrato.label: Vibrato
vibrato.hover: The depth of the automatic vibrato that sets in after the note starts. Range 0 to 1.

vib_hz.label: Vibrato rate
vib_hz.hover: How fast the vibrato wavers. Range 2 to 9 Hz.

flutter.label: Flutter by shake
flutter.hover: How much flutter tongue a shake (the motion input) adds. Range 0 to 1.

flut_hz.label: Flutter rate
flut_hz.hover: How fast the flutter tongue rolls. Range 8 to 40 Hz.

life.label: Life
life.hover: Micro-randomness: 0 every note identical, 1 each one slightly different. Range 0 to 1.

growl.label: Growl
growl.hover: The depth of the throaty growl when the note is pushed hard: 0 off. Range 0 to 1.

growl_from.label: Growl from
growl_from.hover: The pressure where the growl sets in. Range 0 to 1.5.

growl_hz.label: Growl rate
growl_hz.hover: How fast the throat flutters in the growl. Range 10 to 80 Hz.

pair.label: Second player
pair.hover: The level of a second, slightly detuned player: 0 solo. Range 0 to 1.

detune.label: Detune
detune.hover: How far the second player is detuned. Range 0 to 30 cents.
